svg.title: G-code cutter-sweep review preview
svg.desc: Exact XY line-segment sweeps from the emitted single-tool program. Brown is the shallow 0.4 mm pocket sweep; blue is the 4 mm hanger hole; red is the deep outside profile; amber is the same outside path at the tab-lift Z, retaining nominal 0.8 mm tabs. Stock XY is 110 by 110 mm.
svg.text: Amber: tab spans at Z -2.2 • nominal 0.8 retained
Exact XY sweeps; Z depth is encoded by color. Stock 110 × 110 mm, work origin lower left.
